drafts.hint: Uses the Generate tab's settings and only changes the seed, drawing each candidate part of the way. Pick the ones you like and draw them to the end.
drafts.empty.title: No drafts yet
drafts.empty.description: Choose a count and a position, then press Make drafts to line up half-drawn candidates.
drafts.onlyTxt2img: Drafts work with text to image only (remove the reference image)
drafts.notReady: The Generate tab is not ready yet
drafts.editModel: Edit models (Flux Fill, Flux Kontext, Qwen-Image-Edit) only change a source picture, so they cannot make drafts. Pick another model for the drafts.
drafts.leftOut: Not in the list: {names} (edit models only change a source picture and cannot make drafts)
